label: First Roar — whatever you intend
candidates: You roar. Everyone who witnesses it is frightened, whatever you intend.
Roar. All who witness the line are pushed to fear — the flame's color does not protect them.
This is Roar. It frightens everyone who sees it, no matter what the flame carries.
You can roar a path through stone. Everyone who witnesses the break feels fear.
Roar shatters the ground ahead. Witness it and you are frightened — your alignment, theirs, nothing stops this.
When you roar, the earth breaks and all who see it are afraid. The flame cannot change this.
Roar. The line frightens every witness regardless of what you feel or what they do.
You roar and the stone splits. Fear reaches everyone in sight of the break, even those already aligned to you.
